data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Stlican Shelf and Callahan's Passage See Fresh Fighting
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last bulletin, Stlican Shelf has not slackened: ten strategic-base events in the two hours before cutoff, and forty-four on the day, with The Pale House and Vulpine Watch the busiest points. Callahan's Passage, quieter in the previous edition, has returned to the board with three fresh events in two hours and five in six; The Latch has changed hands again as the leading point. Weathered Expanse, though without a base event in the final two hours, still posted five in six and twenty in the day, all at Spirit Watch, with casualties climbing sharply. Fishermans Row, which sprang up in the earlier bulletin, cooled in the last two hours after six six-hour events centered on Arcadia and Eidolo. MarbanHollow and Stonecradle continue to see slow action at Mox and The Long Fast. DeadLands, formerly the heaviest front, has had no strategic-base event in six hours despite continuing heavy casualties. No victory has been declared.
